rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when saying that something is probably true based on the available facts.

example.english: Given the bus schedule, they have plausibly already arrived.
example.traditional: 睇返班車時間，佢好可能已經到咗。
example.jyutping: tai2 faan2 baan1 ce1 si4 gaan1 keoi5 hou2 ho2 nang4 ji5 ging1 dou3 zo2

rows.note: Use this when the conclusion follows from what one would normally expect or infer from the facts.

example.english: It will plausibly clear up tomorrow.
example.jyutping: ziu3 gai3 ting1 jat6 jing1 goi1 wui5 fong3 cing4

rows.note: Use this when someone says or does something in a convincing way, such as lying believably.

example.english: They lied so plausibly that even I almost believed them.
example.traditional: 佢講大話講到似模似樣咁，差啲連我都信咗。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gong2 daai6 waa6 gong2 dou3 ci5 mou4 ci5 joeng2 gam3 caa1 di1 lin4 ngo5 dou1 seon3 zo2
